title: A session that fits the time you have
description: Pick a home workout by the minutes and equipment available, counting the warm-up and the transitions.

blocks.text: Sometimes there is only a short gap for a session — ten minutes in the morning, say. The user wants to know before starting whether the whole chosen format fits into it.

quote.text: This app gives me no excuse… I can get up 10 minutes earlier than I normally would, and squeeze and work out.

blocks.text: Select prepared sessions by the time and the equipment available. Include the introduction, the transitions required and the program’s pauses in the duration, and keep the place when someone stops. Don’t trim a long routine automatically for the sake of a neat number.
Check that a person actually has time
Look at the real time from start to finish, including clearing a space. If “ten minutes” needs another fifteen before and after, the filter doesn’t solve the original problem.
